# ESS specification

Loom is specified in ESS. These pages are generated from the repository's `ess/` directory by `loom-docs`, which runs `ess generate --kind docs`. They change when the specification changes, and `task check` fails if they fall behind it.

| domain | what it covers |
|---|---|
| [Run](./loom-run.md) | One model session executing a commission's run. Each catalogue is projected from one frontier; a selection names one action from that catalogue; arguments are generated for the selected action only. Loom never decides authority or completion. |
